title: not + anybody/anyone/anything nobody/no-one/nothing
summary: Отрицание с anybody/anyone/anything и nobody/no-one/nothing: в предложении только одно отрицание.
ru:
## Две пары слов
| про людей | про вещи |
|---|---|
| not + **anybody / anyone** | not + **anything** |
| **nobody / no-one** | **nothing** |
**anybody = anyone**, **nobody = no-one** — это одно и то же.

## not + anybody / anyone / anything
Отрицательный глагол + **any-**:
> I don't know **anybody** here. — Я здесь никого не знаю.
> There isn't **anyone** in the room. — В комнате никого нет.
> I can't remember **anything**. — Я ничего не помню.

## nobody / no-one / nothing
Положительный глагол + **no-**:
> There is **nobody** in the room. = There isn't anybody in the room.
> She said **nothing**. = She didn't say anything.
> There's **nothing** to eat. — Есть нечего.

## В начале предложения и как ответ
В начале предложения нужно только **nobody / no-one / nothing** (не *anybody*).
> **Nobody** lives here. — Здесь никто не живёт.
> **Nothing** happened. — Ничего не случилось.
> — Who did you meet? — **No-one.** — Кого ты встретил? — Никого.
> — What did you say? — **Nothing.** — Что ты сказал? — Ничего.

## Главное правило
В английском предложении **только одно отрицание**:
- ~~I don't know nothing.~~ → I don't know **anything**. / I know **nothing**.
- ~~Don't tell nobody.~~ → Don't tell **anybody**.
- ~~There isn't nobody here.~~ → There isn't **anybody** here. / There is **nobody** here.
(В русском: «Я **ничего не** знаю» — два отрицания, в английском нельзя!)
en:
## Two groups
| people | things |
|---|---|
| not + **anybody / anyone** | not + **anything** |
| **nobody / no-one** | **nothing** |
**anybody = anyone**, **nobody = no-one**.

## not + anybody / anyone / anything
> I don't know **anybody** here.
> There isn't **anyone** in the room.
> I can't remember **anything**.

## nobody / no-one / nothing
A positive verb + **no-**:
> There is **nobody** in the room. = There isn't anybody in the room.
> She said **nothing**. = She didn't say anything.
> There's **nothing** to eat.

## At the start of a sentence and as an answer
We use **nobody / no-one / nothing** (not *anybody*) at the beginning of a sentence.
> **Nobody** lives here. · **Nothing** happened.
> — Who did you meet? — **No-one.**
> — What did you say? — **Nothing.**

## The key rule
One negative in a sentence is enough:
- ~~I don't know nothing.~~ → I don't know **anything**. / I know **nothing**.
- ~~Don't tell nobody.~~ → Don't tell **anybody**.
structure:
## Схема
| Значение | Отрицательный глагол + | Положительный глагол + |
|---|---|---|
| никто (люди) | not + anybody / anyone | nobody / no-one |
| ничто (вещи) | not + anything | nothing |

## Примеры пар
> I didn't see **anybody**. = I saw **nobody**.
> He doesn't want **anything**. = He wants **nothing**.
> There isn't **anyone** here. = There is **no-one** here.

## Формула
> **nobody / no-one / nothing** + глагол (в утверждении)
> **not** + глагол + **anybody / anyone / anything**

## Ответ на вопрос
> Who ...? → **Nobody. / No-one.**
> What ...? → **Nothing.**

## Правописание
> **no-one** пишется через дефис (или **no one**); **nobody**, **nothing** — слитно.
